numerics.averaging_window_note: consecutive 400000-step (0.56 us at 1.4 ps) windows; the reported maps are the last completed window (or the current one if at least half full); the v2.0.3 gates read the same 400000-step window
numerics.checkpoint_note: checkpoint-latest.{json,npz} rewritten atomically every 40000 steps (56 ns); n_g and the atom ledgers are in the checkpoint arrays; series.jsonl / status.jsonl appended at every 200-step sync
numerics.dt_justification: 1.4 ps (v2: 1.5 ps): omega_pe dt at the v2 window peak 1.64e18 m^-3 is 0.101 (0.108 at 1.5 ps; gate 0.2); the attempt-8 resolution analysis asked dt <= 1.48 ps for omega_pe dt <= 0.16 (20 % under the gate) at the plume peak 3.7e18 - adopted here so the refinement also has time-step margin; electron Courant at 400 eV: 1.19e7 m/s x 1.4 ps = 16.6 um = 0.50 cells of 33.3 um (gate 1 cell); omega_ce dt at the channel max |B| 0.291 T: 0.072. Step-count conversions: 200-step series interval = 0.28 ns, 40000-step checkpoint = 56 ns, 400000-step window = 0.56 us, one ion transit (2.4 us) = 1 714 286 steps, 3 transits = 5 142 858 steps
numerics.frame_recorder_note: v2.0 frame recorder ON (28 ns frames): the effect's ionisation / density / potential structure at the cusp planes against the v4 frames (0d228ad2) - with SEE the frames gain wall_see_flux_per_m2_s / wall_see_effective_yield / wall_see_mean_energy_ev; frames are diagnostics, not gates
numerics.neutral_update_note: the inventory is advanced at every series interval (= sync interval) with the ionisations tallied over that interval

peak_debye_gate.max_cells_per_debye_note: v2.0.3 window-mode gate (spec/pic2d/pic2d-model-v2.0.json gates_v2_0.peak_debye_gate_v2_0_3): the gated statistic is max(dr, dz) / lambda_D at the densest node of the trailing 400000-step (0.56 us) interval average among nodes with mean occupancy >= 32 macro-electrons, with the window's moment T_e (the maps.npz construction). HARD pi (the Birdsall-Langdon CIC finite-grid-instability threshold; plume attempt 8 heated from ~3.2, the v2 base plateau sat at 3.17), fail-closed once the window is complete. SOFT 2.5 (20 % margin) is a plateau precondition (plateau.peak_debye_soft_ok), never a stop. Expected here: the v2 base peak 1.64e18 m^-3 / 7.39 eV gives lambda_D 15.8 um -> 33.3 um / 15.8 um = 2.11 (a 16 % margin to the soft level; the soft level is reached if the resolved peak densifies by 40 % at fixed T_e, e.g. 2.3e18 at 7.4 eV, or cools to 5.3 eV at 1.64e18); the hard level needs 3.6e18 at 7.4 eV. A plateau above 2.5 is recorded as 'resolution margin not met' (acceptance (a) fails, run continues to the budget) - a legitimate outcome, not a defect.
peak_debye_gate.min_accumulated_macro_particle_steps_at_: v2.0.6 (spec gates_v2_0.peak_debye_gate_accumulated_floor_v2_0_6): the gated node is the densest node whose ACCUMULATED macro-electron-steps over the 400 000-step window reach 64 000 (= 32 crossings x ~2000 steps), so axis columns that hold < 32 macro-electrons per step but are visited by many are gate-able (the v2.0.3 mean-occupancy floor of 32 made them invisible); on the v4 maps the gated statistic is unchanged (2.154 at the same node, resolved nodes 19 650 -> 42 130); the mean-occupancy floor stays recorded alongside
peak_debye_gate.min_macro_particles_at_peak_note: mean occupancy over the window; the v2 peak node (14, 286) held ~300 macro-electrons per step at W 6e4 (node volume 1.1e-11 m^3); at W 2.667e4 on the 33.3 um grid the corresponding node (r 0.7 mm: volume 2pi r dr dz = 4.9e-12 m^3) holds ~300 as well (same particles per cell); axis nodes (volume pi (dr/2)^2 dz / ... ~ 1e-14 m^3) stay below the floor

performance.moment_sample_interval_note: v2.0.5: electron window moments (T_e maps, peak-Debye T_e, sample counts) sampled every 5th accumulated step; physics bitwise, gated Delta/lambda_D moves by 1.7e-5 median vs K = 1 (8aca6c3a); enters config_sha256 by the v2.0.5 identity policy (K != 1 is a declared configuration); the reference ran K = 1

numerics.poisson: device block-Thomas direct (exact to round-off, true-residual contract 1e-10 |rhs| verified at every host sync)

see.see_note: model v2.2.0 see_dielectric_v1 (spec pic2d-model-v2.2.json): electron impacts on the dielectric wall (boundary code 3: channel wall + cone stair) emit floor(delta) + Bernoulli(frac) macro-electrons of the impacting weight from the Vaughan yield delta(E, theta) with the BN constants delta_max 2.016 at 299 eV, threshold 0.0 eV, k_rise 0.563 (Vaughan fit of Villemant et al. 2019 as tabulated by PICLas; first crossover 35.7 eV vs Dunaevsky 2003's 35 eV; flux-averaged yield 0.48 / 0.58 / 0.69 at T_e 5 / 7 / 10 eV, critical temperature 20.3 eV), Sydorenko 2006 split (elastic 0.03, inelastic 0.07, the rest true secondaries as a flux half-Maxwellian at T_see 2 eV, cosine law about the inward normal), ion-induced yield 0, NO Hobbs-Wesson cap (the space-charge-limited state emerges; space_charge_limit_yield 0.9830 = 1 - 8.3 sqrt(m_e / M_Xe) is a diagnostic threshold only). Surface charge changes by absorbed MINUS emitted; ke_see_emitted_j is an injected ledger term. Every field of this block enters config_sha256 through SEEConfig.to_dict; the SEE draws use their own RNG stream (CPU stream 5, Warp seed-table column 4), so the MCC / injection / ion-MCC draws of the reference are reproduced step for step until the first emission. The R2 box shakedown of the ss-v4 protocol with this block (4ca89e72, 2026-09-04 17:26 UTC, non-evidentiary, 100k steps) read I_d 2.06x the SEE-off shakedown's transient value and per-cusp effective yields 0.96-1.00 with NEGATIVE near-wall drops (a virtual cathode) at all three cusps: the cusps sat at the Hobbs-Wesson limit - the per-cusp SCL flag is therefore a primary reading of this campaign, not an afterthought

numerics.step_graph_note: v1.4 CUDA-graph step (bitwise-identical to the direct launches; tests/pic2d/test_pic2d_warp_parity.py)

operating_point.electron_injection_justification: kept from v1.2: v2 ignited from this injection at 1e20 and the v1.2 reference did not at 1.5e19 (beam mirrored back); attempt 1 at 5e19 with the 1e16 seed also did not ignite (91-96 % of the beam returned), so attempt 2 changes the seed, not the injection
operating_point.neutral_density_role: initial density AND MCC null-collision ceiling n_g0 (= Q_in / c, the zero-ionisation fixed point); the instantaneous n_g(t) is the inventory state

neutral_inventory.feed_justification: ATTEMPT 2: Q_in = c n_g0 with c = v_bar A_exit / 4 = 1.5547e-3 m^3/s (xenon at 300 K, v_bar = 220.0 m/s, A_exit = pi (3 mm)^2) and n_g0 = 5.5e19 m^-3: 8.55e16 atoms/s = 0.01864 mg/s. Expected fixed point where nu_iz tau = 1: n_g ~ 3.4e19 with S = Q_in - c n_g = 3.3e16 s^-1 (38 % utilisation) and n_eq = S / (V nu_iz) ~ 2.3e17 (0.58 n_max) if the plasma electrons carry the ionisation; lower if the beam does. Attempt 1 used n_g0 = 5e19 (Q_in = 7.77e16 = 0.01695 mg/s; fixed point at 3.4e19 would have been S = 2.5e16, n_eq ~ 1.8e17) and did not ignite - see 'attempts'
neutral_inventory.relaxation_justification: tau_g = 30 ns is artificial: << ion transit 2.4 us (n_g quasi-steady on plasma time scales), << physical effusion time V/c = 221 us, = 100 series intervals (averages the interval shot noise of S). Only the fixed point is physical; the artificial term has its own ledger so the atom balance closes to round-off

operating_point.seed_justification: ATTEMPT 2: the seed used by the v1 and v2 snapshots (5e16 m^-3, 5 eV; 286 k macro-particles per species at W = 6e4), which ignited at 1e20 with the beam fully absorbed from the first 100 ns (exit return 0.9 -> 0.26 mA, anode 3.2-3.6 mA, nu_iz 2.8-4.2e6 s^-1, T_e rising 8 -> 10 eV). Attempt 1 used 1e16 and the seed cooled (T_e 7.9 -> 5.0 eV) with nu_iz falling 1.16e6 -> 5.6e5 s^-1 and 91-96 % of the beam mirroring back; a 5x denser seed builds the plasma potential structure that traps the beam electrons (the beam-transmission jump between 5e19 and 1e20 was 23x in ionisations per injected electron, far more than the 2x in collisionality, pointing at the potential structure rather than the collision rate). The seed is a documented initial condition, not a sustained source: it is not replenished
operating_point.unchanged_note: EVERY operating-point key is bit-for-bit the v2 attempt-2 value (300 V, 0 V exit, n_g0 5.5e19, feed 8.551e16 /s, tau_g 30 ns, exit-plane injection 3 mA @ 2 eV, seed 5e16 m^-3 @ 5 eV, cold ions); the refinement changes the grid, the time step and the macro-weight only

preregistration.one_execution: one detached launch per case from the scheduler's worktree at the preregistration commit, one MPS slot each, in the declared priority order as slots free (after the R1 queue: ext-val bohm-0.4 -> alpha-1over64 -> alpha-0.345); a wall-budget stop may be resumed (new session, same identity, disclosed); no parameter is changed after the freeze
preregistration.preflight: preflight-<case>.json on the launch box (real P2 field on the 90 x 720 grid, mesh, factorisation, memory, ms/step at the seed load and at a synthetic ~4.5 M-particle load, GPU load before) - non-evidentiary; the budget is derived from it
preregistration.protocol: protocols/<case>.json is frozen at the preregistration commit (its sha256 is listed in the campaign protocol.json); summary.json records protocol_sha256 and git_head; run.py launch refuses a dirty worktree, a HEAD that is not the recorded preregistration commit, a sealed protocol that differs from its recomposition, or an existing execution lock
preregistration.shakedown: shakedown-<case>.json: a 100 000-step real-input run of EVERY case (results-shakedown/<case>/, cadences shrunk, every gate live) through run -> finalize -> assess (case and campaign) on the launch box - non-evidentiary, not committed beyond the record; the earlier R2 / R3 shakedowns ($WORK/r2/shakedown-see-bn.json at 4ca89e72, pic2d_xe_collision_set_v2_shakedown at 6defd5ed) ran other code trees and other protocols (no K = 5, no Debye floor, pre-rebase seed-stream layout) and are NOT reused as this campaign's shakedowns

corrected_ledger.statement: the reference FAILS its own acceptance (b) on the corrected ledger: +2.46 % of the electrode work in the trailing 400 000-step window at the stop (recorded -7.67 % before the v2.0.6 W fix; still rising at the plateau). It is the campaign's SEE-off / legacy-set point AS RECORDED, not a clean reference: every difference reported against it carries this caveat, and a case that passes (b) while the reference does not is itself a finding about the effect (less finite-grid heating at a lower peak density or temperature)

reference_run.particle_band_note: the 50 um convergence pair's relative bands (seed-b / W x 0.7; the v4 c-tolerances are 2x these): a shift smaller than the band is reported as 'inside the particle band' and does not count as an effect; the IEDF low-energy fraction has NO replicate band - the declared absolute detection band 0.03 (~40 % of the reference fraction 0.067, > 3x the largest relative particle band applied to it) is a preregistered choice; anode_ion_a, wall_electron_power_w and wall_ion_mean_energy_ev have no band: reported with their hypothesis signs, never judged
reference_run.plateau: 3.033 transits (7.28 us, 5.2 M steps, 5.0 h), stop plateau_reached_after_min_transit_times; window [4.8 M, 5.2 M] steps; verdict vs the 50 um base: resolution_limited
quantities_added_by_this_campaign: iedf_low_energy_fraction (exit-plane IEDF counts with bin centre < 0.1 x anode = 30 eV, from maps.npz)
wall_electron_power_w (e x wall_electron_flux x area x wall_electron_mean_energy, summed over the channel wall cells of maps.npz)

simplifications: neutrals: 0-D quasi-steady inventory, uniform in space (no neutral flow field, no local depletion where the ionisation is, no wall accommodation); feed prescribed, exit-plane thermal effusion at 300 K; the transient toward the fixed point is artificial (tau_g = 30 ns vs the physical 221 us) and only the fixed point is physical
no ion-neutral collisions (elastic or charge exchange)
electron-neutral: isotropic elastic without the 2 m_e/M energy loss, one lumped 8.32 eV excitation, single ionisation with Vahedi-Surendra secondary energy and isotropic emission
exit plane: Dirichlet 0 V cathode/neutraliser reference; electrons injected there as a flux-weighted half-Maxwellian at fixed current
anode: perfectly absorbing conductor at fixed potential
cone wall represented as a one-cell stair-step of the plasma cell mask
prescribed static B from the P2 solution (no plasma-induced field); bilinear node interpolation of the C1 bicubic psi field
ions pushed every 8 steps with 8 dt (frozen in between; births added to the ion charge immediately)
electrostatic only, azimuthally symmetric: no azimuthal instabilities/anomalous transport
momentum-conserving bilinear scheme: energy is not exactly conserved; the ledger (with electrode work) residual is reported; a resume restarts the interval ledger

3 mA injection at 0.017 mg/s feed: a real CFT runs at 0.1-1 A and 0.1-1 mg/s; the self-consistent fixed point of the ionisation-depletion balance, not the absolute current or flow, is the object of this run

dielectric wall: secondary electron emission from BN (Vaughan fit of Villemant 2019 + Sydorenko split, T_see 2 eV, ion-induced yield 0, no Hobbs-Wesson cap - the space-charge-limited state emerges) with accumulated surface charge = absorbed - emitted; zero field in the dielectric backing (perfect insulator); no sputtering, no surface conditioning / aging (Tondu 2011), no energy-dependent backscatter fractions
no anomalous cross-field transport (alpha = 0): the R1 alpha-series carries that closure; every discharge quantity here is conditional on alpha = 0 (audit section 6)
single seed per case: the shifts are judged against the recorded 50 um particle band, not a per-case replicate; the IEDF low-energy fraction has no replicate band (declared absolute band 0.03)
the reference (ss-v4) heats at +2.46 % of the electrode work on the corrected ledger: differences against it carry that caveat
preregistered physics-effect study of a development model: no experimental validation, not a performance prediction

acceptance.a_plateau: stop_reason == plateau_reached_after_min_transit_times under the v4 rule (>= 3 transits = 5 142 858 steps, trailing-20 % drifts of I_d, N_e, n_g < 5 %, triad soft bounds, window-mode peak-Debye soft margin 2.5)
acceptance.b_residual_power: summary.grid_heating_triad.windowed_energy_residual_over_electrode_work (trailing 400 000-step ratio at the stop, v2.0.6 W-corrected ledger) < +0.02, one-sided; the reference reads +0.0246 on the corrected ledger (FAIL) - a case that passes (b) is a cleaner plateau than the reference

collision_set: exit-plane IEDF: low-energy fraction (< 30 eV), fraction below 0.5 x anode, mean / peak energy vs the v4 IEDF
fast-neutral exit momentum rate (pz_fast_neutral_exit over the trailing window from series.jsonl; run average as the witness) and exit kinetic-energy rate
level shares of the four excitations
see: series see_* trailing-20 % means (wall potential mean / min / max, plasma-minus-wall drop, cumulative effective yield, emitted power, backscattered fraction)
cusps at or above the Hobbs-Wesson limit (count of 3)

cusp_sheath_drop_v.expected: -10 to -45 % (delta_eff 0.3-0.9; Hobbs-Wesson factor T_e ln(1/(1 - delta_eff)))
cusp_sheath_drop_v.reason: the emitted electron current lowers the floating-wall potential drop; per cusp, read beside the effective yield and the SCL flag

discharge_current_a.reason: more electrons reach the anode through the lowered cusp sheaths; near-wall conductivity

peak_n_e_window_per_m3.reason: the wall no longer confines the electrons: the density that builds before the cusps falls

t_e_peak_window_ev.reason: the emitted cold secondaries (2 eV) and the lower sheath drops cool the hot tail

wall_electron_power_w.reason: the lower sheath admits more primaries; the emitted flux returns part of the energy at T_see

wall_ion_mean_energy_ev.reason: ions fall through a smaller sheath drop

per_cusp.report: per cusp plane (+-1 mm): electron and ion wall current (maps.npz wall fluxes x wall area), the axis-to-wall potential drop, the near-wall drop phi[wall - 3 cells] - phi[wall] (negative = non-monotonic sheath / virtual cathode), the near-wall T_e, the wall-ion mean impact energy; with SEE: the effective yield (emitted / impacting over the window, from wall_see_flux_per_m2_s), the SEE current, the mean emitted energy and the SCL flag (effective yield >= space_charge_limit_yield 0.983 OR near-wall drop < 0); reported beside the v4 values, signs judged by the hypothesis rows cusp_sheath_drop_v (never in the verdict: no band is measured)

c_shifts.rule: for every quantity the shift (case - reference) is reported: relative for the plateau quantities with the ss-v4 particle band, ABSOLUTE for the IEDF low-energy fraction with the declared band 0.03. A shift with a declared '+' / '-' hypothesis counts as CONFIRMING when it has the declared sign AND exceeds the band, CONTRADICTING when it has the opposite sign AND exceeds the band, INSIDE THE BAND otherwise; a '0' hypothesis is CONFIRMING inside the band and CONTRADICTING beyond it in either direction; quantities without a band (anode_ion_a, wall_electron_power_w, wall_ion_mean_energy_ev, the collision / fast-neutral rates) are REPORTED with their hypothesis sign and never judged

combined_vs_sum_of_parts.applies_to: see-bn+xe-set-v2, evaluated by `assess --campaign` once all three cases have an assessment
combined_vs_sum_of_parts.hypothesis: no interaction sign is predeclared: SEE acts through the sheaths, the collision set through the ion population; the audit gives no reason to expect either sign, so the statement is a measurement
combined_vs_sum_of_parts.rule: for every banded quantity: interaction = shift(combined) - [shift(see-bn) + shift(xe-set-v2)]; ADDITIVE when |interaction| <= band, SUPER_ADDITIVE when |interaction| > band and interaction has the sign of the sum of parts (the combined effect exceeds the sum), SUB_ADDITIVE when |interaction| > band and it opposes the sum (the effects partly cancel / saturate); the statement is 'additive' when every banded quantity is ADDITIVE, 'interacting' otherwise, 'not_evaluable' unless all three cases reached (a)

d_verdict.note: the verdict is about the SIGN of each effect on the recorded plateau; the magnitudes are the measurement. Neither effect is 'tuned': the BN constants and the cross sections are the declared literature values

per_case_hypothesis_verdict.confirmed: (a) reached AND every key quantity is CONFIRMING AND no hypothesis quantity with a band is CONTRADICTING
per_case_hypothesis_verdict.inconclusive: NOT (a), OR (a) reached with no contradiction but some key quantity INSIDE THE BAND (the effect is smaller than the particle band)
per_case_hypothesis_verdict.not_confirmed: (a) reached AND at least one hypothesis quantity with a band is CONTRADICTING - a finding about the effect's sign, recorded as such

plateau_status.no_plateau: NOT (a): budget / gate stop; trailing-window quantities reported
plateau_status.plateau_clean: (a) AND (b): a quotable plateau of the effect
plateau_status.plateau_heating: (a) but NOT (b): the plateau heats above 2 % (like the reference); the shifts are reported with the heating caveat

acceptance.declared: predeclared before the launch; evaluated by `run.py assess --case <case>` (per case) and `run.py assess --campaign` (the three cases and the additivity statement) against reference_run (the recorded ss-v4 plateau); verdicts recorded in results/<case>/assessment.json and results/campaign-assessment.json (results-only commits)

stopping_rule.fail_closed: runtime omega_pe dt gate (0.2), v2.0.6 window-mode peak-node Debye gate (accumulated-particle-step floor) (hard pi cells per lambda_D on the 400000-step interval-averaged peak, once the window is complete), grid-heating triad hard drift bounds (S, T_e,dense, omega_pe dt drifts >= 0.25 after one transit) and the v2.0.3 windowed residual-power bound on the v2.0.6 W-corrected ledger (trailing-400000-step ledger residual >= 5 % of the electrode work, one-sided, from the first complete window), one-cell Courant crossing, Poisson residual contract, neutral inventory exhaustion or ceiling violation: PIC2DStabilityError / triad stop ends the run with the artifacts written; v2.2.0: an overflow of the Warp SEE birth reservation (256 + N_e / 1000 per step) fails closed at the sync

grid_heating_triad.note: v1.4 triad drift members (soft 5 % = plateau precondition; hard 25 % after one transit) + v2.0.3 windowed residual-power hard gate (one-sided, 5 % of the electrode work over the trailing 400000 steps, from the first complete window); the cumulative ratio is recorded as the witness with its 10 % bound as a plateau precondition only. Calibration: the v2 base window ratios were -12.7 % (seed window) rising monotonically to -0.2 % at the plateau (max +0.37 %); seed-b -12.8 -> -1.5 %; w-0.7 -12.7 -> -4.2 %; attempt 8 crossed +5 % at ~3.1 us and reached +54.8 %; v2.0.6: the ledger's inelastic_loss_j carries W, so the windowed statistic IS the corrected one (the recorded ss-v4 series read -7.7 % where the corrected value was +2.46 %); the new sinks / sources (ion_neutral_loss_j, ke_see_emitted_j) are booked, so the residual stays the numerical-heating witness

stopping_rule.ignition_check: the seed and injection are the ones that ignited v2 attempt 2 (and seed-b, w-0.7): S growing and N_e rising by ~1 us with n_g heading toward ~3e19; NO adjustment is allowed under this preregistration - a non-ignition is a recorded outcome of the refinement, not a reason to relaunch
stopping_rule.plateau: relative drift < 5 % over the trailing 20 % of the elapsed simulated time for the discharge current, the plasma electron count AND the neutral density (linear fit, drift = slope x window / |mean|), evaluated at every checkpoint; may only be declared after >= 3 ion transit times (3 x 2.4 us = 7.2 us = 5 142 858 steps); additionally the grid-heating triad must be inside its soft bounds (plateau.triad_soft_ok) AND the window-mode peak-Debye soft margin must hold (plateau.peak_debye_soft_ok: trailing-window Delta/lambda_D at the peak <= 2.5) - the v2 base rule plus the v2.0.3 preconditions
stopping_rule.wall_budget_note: 13.7 h = 1.5 x 9.05 h (launch-box plateau-load preflight 6.33 ms/step with 4 other MPS clients x 5142858 steps to 3 transits), rounded up to 10 min; preflight-see-bn.json
